ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; estimated <10% white/light-grey area against a >90% black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly uniform low-intensity (black) surface; high-contrast pixels are limited to narrow, localized linear streaks and small punctate clusters across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence point; estimated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge; irregular pixel-depth variations ranging from fine-tooth jaggedness to larger notched segments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed structure showing a slightly concave sweep from the notch before curving toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, irregular white pixel clusters concentrated on the far distal tips of both lobes, presenting significant relief against the dark background.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, high-contrast linear marks; includes distinct parallel rake-like scratches on the left lobe and long diagonal abrasions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) and heavy barnacle encrustation on the lateral margins and fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, near-horizontal white linear mark crossing the lower central region of the fluke just above the median notch.
